reason: Conversation 1 ignored the homeowner's clear, repeated report of a visibly cracked lower spray arm, chased irrelevant leak/flood-tray lines of questioning, and ended by refusing to diagnose and sending her to an engineer for a trivial, obvious fault. Conversation 2 correctly confirmed the cracked arm as the cause, had her sensibly check hub, mount, filters and nozzles, correctly declined to quote a part number without the product code, and told her exactly how to identify the right lower spray arm from the rating plate, plus useful limescale advice. Conversation 2 matches the hidden truth and expected handling on every point; Conversation 1 failed on diagnosis, efficiency, escalation and part advice.
